_meta.package: TSLP-2-1, 1.0 x 0.6 x 0.4(+0.1) mm, terminals 0.65 pitch
_meta.notes: Pin 1 = cathode (cathode marking bar at pin-1 end, top view p.14). Marking FF. Not AEC-Q101. VR 40 V. Recommended land: 2x 0.6 x 0.35 copper, 0.3 gap; one 0.6 x 1.0 solder-mask opening over both pads.
